g.text: > Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.
> Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test with local results and an MCPJam identity
`mcpjam test <file>` runs an MCPJam suite file locally: it connects your MCP servers, drives each case's prompts through a model,
grades the transcript with the same assertions a hosted run uses, and decides the run with
Results are **never uploaded**. The command writes results to your terminal and, if you ask, to a report file. It records the run
start with MCPJam. Like every command, it sends the CLI's single anonymous [telemetry](htt
Run `mcpjam cloud login` locally, or set `MCPJAM_API_KEY` to an organization `sk_` key in CI. The SDK also accepts `apiKey` or `mc
pjamAuth` in run options. Explicit credentials take precedence over `MCPJAM_API_KEY`, whic
Every logical run needs an online start response. MCPJam retries transient failures within ten seconds, then stops before executio
n. A prior successful run does not enable offline execution. The CLI resolves the project
With results uploads disabled, the start-run request sends only the credential in the authorization header, any MCPJam API headers
you configure through the SDK's `inference.resolveMcpjam`, project selection, a new run-s
`DO_NOT_TRACK`, `MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED`, and CLI telemetry settings disable analytics, not the required run-start request. Res
ults remain local unless result uploading is enabled separately.
